title: Milestone: a single-screen barrel-dodging platformer
prompt: Build an original single-screen platformer in this folder: index.html plus game.js (and more files if you like), canvas 800×600, plain JavaScript. A player that runs (ArrowLeft/ArrowRight), jumps (Space) and climbs ladders (ArrowUp/ArrowDown) across four sloped girders; barrels that roll down from the top, fall down the ladders at random, and end the run on contact; a point for each barrel jumped; three lives; and a goal at the top that wins the level. Draw everything with canvas shapes in your own style; no images. Plan the work with update_plan, check the page with ys_check_page as you go, and fix what it reports.
